about_the_game:
See behind-the-scenes in this hour-long featurette chronicling the making of Mars Attracts! In this candid interview with the developers, you'll see the ups, the downs, and everything in between with an exclusive look at what goes into making an indie game like Mars Attracts.
  • Discover how a small indie team managed to secure the Mars Attacks license, and what is really involved with licensing an IP
  • See the earliest prototypes of the game, and how they morphed into the release version
  • Hear the developers thoughts on the reactions to the viral announcement trailer
  • Witness the evolution of core game systems like rides, experiments, and expeditions through multiple design iterations

installation

After purchasing and installing the DLC, the video will be in the folder "Mars Attracts Featurette" under the root folder where Mars Attracts is installed.

For example, on Windows , this folder would typically be "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Mars Attracts".

If you are unsure where the game is installed, navigate to Mars Attracts in your Steam library, right click and select "Properties > Local Files > Browse local files".
